# dispatch summary

## Config loading
`launcher.py` now loads every job file through `worker_cfg.load_worker_config`; the private `load_job_config` parser is gone and
`LaunchSpec.config` exposes the `WorkerConfig`.

## Preflight
Tamper evidence for high-tier runs: still enforced — the launcher keeps its preflight check and refuses high-tier jobs without an evidence log.
